claims.text: Under automated sync without selfHeal, a change made in the cluster (kubectl scale of the api to 4) makes the Application OutOfSync, Argo CD starts no sync, and the api keeps running with 4 replicas (observed after 30 s).
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: User Guide > Automated Sync Policy > Automatic Self-Healing; outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/gitops-self-heal.txt lines 1-3

claims.text: selfHeal and prune are boolean fields under spec.syncPolicy.automated of an Application; apps/staging.yaml sets both to true (lines 24-25), staging-auto.yaml sets both to false.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: Automated Sync Policy (YAML examples); apps/staging.yaml:22-25, deploy/gitops/lessons/staging-auto.yaml @ stage-3

claims.text: With selfHeal: true, Argo CD also starts a sync when the live objects drift from Git, without a commit; the api returns to the 2 replicas Git declares shortly after kubectl scale (within the script's 120 s wait, no refresh asked).
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: Automated Sync Policy > Automatic Self-Healing; gitops-self-heal.sh:53-57 and output last line @ stage-3

claims.text: Argo CD keeps comparing live objects with the manifests in Git without anyone running a command, unlike OpenTofu (drift found only at plan). On its own it rereads Git every few minutes and follows live objects as they change.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: Architecture (application controller continuously monitors); Automated Sync Policy (timeout.reconciliation); OpenTofu docs: plan

claims.text: An automated sync applies every object of the Application, not only the files the commit changed; the scaled api differs from Git, so an unrelated commit's sync resets it to Git's replicas (output: 'after the sync of that commit: 2 replicas').
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: Sync Options (Selective Sync: 'when syncing using auto sync Argo CD applies every object in the application'); gitops-self-heal.sh:26-35 and output line 6 @ stage-3

claims.text: Without prune: true, removing a manifest from the folder leaves its object running; the Application is OutOfSync and the resource is marked requiresPruning=true in .status.resources. While prune is off, no automated sync deletes it.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: Automated Sync Policy > Automatic Pruning; Sync Options (out of sync if a resource is expected to be pruned); gitops-self-heal.sh:36-43 and output lines 7-8 @ stage-3

claims.text: Without selfHeal, a change made in the live cluster does not trigger an automated sync, even though it makes the Application OutOfSync.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: Automated Sync Policy ('By default, changes that are made to the live cluster will not trigger automated sync')

claims.text: Automated sync attempts one sync per commit (and parameters) unless selfHeal is true; with prune: true a sync deletes an object whose manifest left the folder. After apps/staging.yaml is applied, no new commit, a sync at the removal commit deletes prune-demo (NotFound, Synced).
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: Automated Sync Policy (one sync per commit SHA, 'unless selfHeal'; Automatic Pruning); gitops-self-heal.sh:50-52, output lines 11-13 @ stage-3

claims.text: Prune and self-heal act only on objects that are part of the Application (came from its folder); other objects in the namespace donhang are not tracked by it and are left alone.
claims.source_hint: Argo CD docs: Resource Tracking; apps/staging.yaml:18-21 comment @ stage-3

claims.text: apps/staging.yaml is the Application 'staging' in namespace argocd: source envs/staging at targetRevision main of the config repository, destination namespace donhang; lines 4-17 equal staging-auto.yaml apart from comments.
envs/staging/api.yaml declares replicas: 2 for the api Deployment at stage-3.

gitops-self-heal.sh: 9-10 define replicas, sync_status; 13 applies staging-auto.yaml; 20-23 scale 4, refresh, sleep 30; 26-35 commit prune-demo; 36-38 remove it; 40-43 wait OutOfSync, print requiresPruning; 50-57 apps/staging.yaml, scale 4, wait up to 120 s for 2.
app_refresh asks Argo CD to reread Git and compare now (refresh annotation); it does not sync.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-3 scripts/lib/gitops.sh; Argo CD docs: Annotations and Labels (argocd.argoproj.io/refresh)

claims.text: kubectl scale deployment api --replicas=4 changes the live Deployment's spec.replicas, not the manifest in Git. kubectl rollout status (line 56) waits until the rollout completes; it starts nothing.
claims.source_hint: Kubernetes docs: kubectl scale; kubectl rollout status; Deployments > Scaling a Deployment

claims.text: With self-heal on, a fix that must last (e.g. 4 api replicas) should be made as a commit to the config repository rather than with kubectl.
claims.source_hint: Outline item 3 and misconception 3; Argo CD docs: Automatic Self-Healing

claims.text: Leaving self-heal off is defensible when a team wants hand-made changes to stay visible as OutOfSync instead of being erased; the cost is a cluster that runs, for a while, what nobody committed.
claims.source_hint: Opposing view to misconception 3; Argo CD docs: Automatic Self-Healing (off by default)
